description: Real microscopy used as reference and calibration data for the 3D models. Every entry is CC0 or public domain; SHA-256 pins match the scikit-image data registry. Raw files are downloaded by tools/fetch_micrographs.py into assets/raw/ (not committed); tools/build_assets.py derives the committed files under assets/derived/.

entries.title: 3D confocal stack of a cell monolayer (membrane + nuclei)
entries.modality: 3D confocal fluorescence, ZCYX (60, 2, 256, 256), voxel 0.29 x 0.26 x 0.26 um
entries.credit: Allen Institute for Cell Science, via the scikit-image data repository
entries.used_for: Digital-twin colony: 3D cell and nucleus meshes, volume rendering, calibration of cell/nucleus size, neighbour count and monolayer height

entries.title: Human cells undergoing mitosis (DNA stain)
entries.credit: David Root / Jason Moffat, CellProfiler ExampleHuman (Moffat et al. 2006, Cell 124:1283, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2006.01.040)
entries.used_for: Mitotic-index measurement that calibrates the division clock; gallery animation of self-renewal

entries.title: Normal epidermis and dermis (H&E, 10x)
entries.used_for: Reference for the virtual H&E section render mode and the stratified-epithelium morphogenesis scene

entries.title: Mouse kidney tissue, 3D multichannel confocal
entries.modality: 3D confocal fluorescence, ZCYX (16, 3, 512, 512), voxel 1.25 x 1.24 x 1.24 um
entries.credit: Genevieve Buckley, Monash Micro Imaging (2018), via the scikit-image data repository
entries.used_for: Organ-level 3D volume reference (nephron tubules and glomeruli) for the hierarchy and morphogenesis scenes

entries.title: Live imaging of a protein re-localising to the nuclear envelope
entries.credit: Andrea Boni & Jan Ellenberg (Boni et al. 2015, J Cell Biol 209:705, doi:10.1083/jcb.201409133), via the scikit-image data repository
entries.used_for: Measured nuclear-envelope enrichment kinetics; the fitted time constant sets the nuclear-import step for NICD, beta-catenin, GLI and STAT in the single-cell 3D pathway scene

entries.title: Single cell floating in saline (quantitative phase)
entries.modality: digital holographic quantitative phase image, 660 x 550, 0.107 um/px
entries.credit: Paul Mueller et al. (Optics Express 26:10729, 2018, doi:10.1364/OE.26.010729), via the scikit-image data repository
entries.used_for: Reference for the suspended (rounded) cell shape used by the hematopoietic scene

entries.title: Peripheral blood smear, normal erythrocytes (1000x)
entries.credit: Chula PIC Lab, Chula-RBC-12-Dataset (Naruenatthanaset et al. 2021, arXiv:2012.01321)
entries.used_for: Erythrocyte size and central-pallor measurement that validates the Evans-Fung biconcave 3D red-cell model

entries.title: Cell-centre annotations for rbc-smear (x y class)
Blood smear with a lymphocyte among erythrocytes (1000x)
entries.used_for: Reference for the lymphoid end-state (large nucleus, thin cytoplasm rim) in the hematopoiesis scene

entries.title: Human intestinal organoids in 3D culture (bright field)
entries.credit: Timothy Kassis, OrgaQuant test data (Kassis et al. 2019, Sci Rep 9:12479, doi:10.1038/s41598-019-48874-y)
entries.used_for: Organoid size distribution (circle detection) for the 3D organoid morphogenesis scene
